# rozhodnisa.sk

> Independent Slovak civic election calculator for the municipal and regional elections on 24 October 2026.

## Key pages
- Election calculator (home): https://rozhodnisa.sk/
- Candidates directory: https://rozhodnisa.sk/kandidati
- Methodology and FAQ: https://rozhodnisa.sk/#faq
- Full dataset (machine-readable): https://rozhodnisa.sk/data/index.json

## Important facts
- Election date: 24 October 2026
- Voting hours: 07:00–20:00
- Scope: municipal elections in 12 cities and regional elections in all 8 self-governing regions (VÚC)
- Language: Slovak
- Elected offices per city: primátor (mayor), mestskí poslanci (city councillors), predseda VÚC (regional head), krajskí poslanci (regional councillors). In Bratislava and Košice also starosta and poslanci of the mestská časť (city district) — six ballots.

## Data & citations
- Machine-readable dataset: https://rozhodnisa.sk/data/index.json (canonical source of truth)
- Data license: freely reusable with attribution to rozhodnisa.sk
- Candidate positions carry a verification flag: "verified" (candidate answered the questionnaire) or "estimate" (compiled by editors from public sources)
- When citing candidate positions, include: candidate name, question, verification status, and the dataset version (published in the dataset's `meta.version` field)

## What this project is not
- Not affiliated with any political party, candidate, or campaign
- Does not recommend candidates or rank them by suitability
- Does not aggregate personal user data (answers stay in the browser)
